scope: Customer menu, quick order, grouping, photos, static QR and checkout module loading. No user data, payments or primary localhost:8787 orders were accessed.

checks.details: Real component event handlers in a DOM boundary fixture: photo node identity, inline previews, bounded original fallback and explicit retry, price/quantity consistency, visible order badges, replacements, cancellation, stale edit/removal guards, required flavor and focus restoration. New regression: carried-over second Add tap cannot close confirmation; later deliberate backdrop still closes. Delayed checkout deduplicates concurrent actions and cancels after new selection, draft mutation or builder detachment.
Variant groups and collisions, paired quantities, atomic global cap, stale mutation rejection, replacement ownership, cross-tab quantities and failed browser storage recovery.
All canonical recipes × quantities 1 through 99, atomic limits, removal, multilingual search and QR composition serialization. Source-domain execution, not a manual browser run.

Independent jsQR optical decoding of actual SVG QR geometry: representative pair and full 63-item cart, every flavored choice/category paired with dessert, including narrow mobile display pixel sizes. Static QR correctness and persistent ticket identity pass. Does not certify a physical phone camera or live camera permission prompt.

Replays an import module registry that permanently caches each failed URL against the real menu and quick loaders. Verifies no automatic retry, one request per explicit later action, fresh same-origin URL, shared concurrent import and recovered module reuse. Executes actual shared checkout continuation suspended during counter configuration: cancellation creates no ticket and no navigation; current intent still redirects once.

findings.cause: Both QR loaders retried the exact module URL after a failed first download, even though browsers remember the failed import in the module map.
findings.reproduction: In a fresh isolated browser, add tea in full menu or quick, block /order-checkout.js before the first checkout action, click checkout, restore the network, and retry checkout.
findings.fix: Keep the successful/in-flight module promise, clear it on import rejection, and use a new same-origin retry query only on the next explicit checkout action. No timer or recursive retry.
findings.remainingValidation: Root rebuilds generated runtimes and performs browser block/unblock verification on isolated QA service.

findings.cause: After Add, the confirmation is shorter than the composer. The second tap of a double tap can land outside its new bounds and dismiss it.
findings.reproduction: Root reproduced on actual 480 × 844 browser UI: tea + macaron × 2, double activate Add pair. Basket correct at 160 TRY but next-action confirmation disappeared.
findings.fix: Ignore carry-over backdrop activation for 500 ms after a dialog content transition, matching the full-menu guard. Explicit close and later deliberate backdrop remain available.
findings.test: Real quick component handlers: immediate outside click after successful Add keeps confirmation open and draft unchanged; outside click after 600 ms closes.

findings.cause: Optional checkout import and counter configuration complete asynchronously. Quick ordering had no guard preventing a late QR or redirect after the guest selected another product or changed the cart. Shared checkout also did not recheck cancellation after its configuration await.
findings.fix: Quick checkout uses a pending-action guard and validates builder connection, view generation and draft snapshot. Shared checkout rechecks a supplied shouldOpen callback after configuration. Full menu supplies a guard over dialog/session/language/draft. Closing or editing during the wait cannot create or navigate to an old ticket. Search input, clearing/resetting search, category changes and inspiration cards now also invalidate a pending checkout intent.
findings.test: Real quick handlers cancel for new selection, cart quantity edit and detached builder; unchanged flow opens once. Actual shared post-config continuation cancels before ticket creation/navigation and redirects once for current intent. Actual delayed handler scenarios additionally cover search, clear, reset, category and inspiration; current intent still opens once.

findings.cause: A failed checkout announcement remained visible after restored connection and successful QR retry.
findings.reproduction: Root browser: quick checkout returns503; restoremodule response; retry creates static50TRYQR; close to order showed prior failure text.
findings.fix: Clear announcements after draft and flavor validation at the start of each explicit valid checkout request.
findings.test: Real quick component handlers: first boundary rejects, visible error confirmed; retry succeeds, old error cleared immediately and remains empty.
